backup.app.title: Backup & Sync
backup.nav.label: Backup & Sync sections
backup.type.copy.label: Copy new files
backup.type.copy.promise: Adds new and changed files. Never deletes anything at the destination.
backup.type.copy.deleted: Files you delete stay at the destination.
backup.type.mirror.label: Mirror
backup.type.mirror.promise: The destination becomes an exact copy of the source.
backup.type.mirror.deleted: Deleted and replaced files go to a recycle folder at the destination and are kept for a while.
backup.type.archive.label: Archive
backup.type.archive.promise: Saves one compressed .tar.zst file per run. Keeps owners, permissions and links.
backup.type.archive.deleted: Every archive keeps the files as they were at that run.
backup.quirk.case_insensitive: Doesn't tell upper- and lower-case names apart
backup.quirk.ntfs_chars: Some characters in names are stored encoded
backup.quirk.max_file_4g: Can't store files of 4 GB or more
backup.quirk.no_modtime: Limited: changes are detected by size only
backup.quirk.no_hash: Files can't be checked after copying
backup.quirk.no_metadata: Doesn't keep owners, permissions or links
backup.quirk.per_branch_free: Free space is counted per drive in the pool
backup.quirk.daily_quota: Uploads are limited to about 750 GB a day
backup.warn.limited_change_detection: Changes are detected by file size only, so an edit that keeps the size may be missed.
backup.warn.system_disk: This is the system disk. If it fails, the backup is lost with it.
backup.warn.exported_share: This folder is shared on your network. Anyone who can open the share can change or delete the backup.
backup.warn.world_writable: Anyone on your network who can open this drive can change or delete the backup.
backup.check.not_inside: Source and destination don't contain each other
backup.check.allowed_roots: Both folders are in places NivaroOS may back up
backup.check.fs_quirks: The destination can store these files
backup.check.metadata: Owners, permissions and links can be kept
backup.check.dest_marker: The destination is the folder this job wrote to
backup.check.hooks: The apps and VMs to stop exist
backup.check.type_for_dest: The job type suits the destination
backup.check.same_disk: The destination is on a different disk than the source
backup.check.job_overlap: No mirror shares folders with this job
backup.check.overlap_mirror_dest: Mirror “{job}” writes to a folder this job reads from. It removes anything its own source doesn't have, including files this job backs up.
backup.check.overlap_own_mirror_dest: This mirror writes to a folder that job “{job}” reads from. It removes anything its own source doesn't have there.
backup.check.overlap_mirror_source: Mirror “{job}” copies from a folder this job writes to, so it copies this backup too.
backup.cron.monthly_at: On day {dom} of every month at {time}
backup.run.summary.partial: {added} added, {changed} changed, {errors} could not be copied
backup.run.summary.waiting: Paused: this run would affect {pct} % of files ({guard_key}). Review it to continue.
backup.run.summary.interrupted: Interrupted by a restart. It runs again automatically.

backup.log.vm_was_off: {vm} was already off and stays off

backup.log.marker_written: Marked the destination folder as this job's
backup.log.replayed: Restarted apps and VMs that an earlier, interrupted run had stopped
backup.log.lines_omitted: {count} more lines like these were left out to keep the log small. The last ones follow.
backup.reason.exists: a file with that name is already there
backup.reason.identical: the file there is already the same
backup.reason.unsafe_path: its path would lead outside the restore folder
backup.reason.special_file: this kind of file can't be restored there
backup.notify.waiting: {job} is paused: it would affect {pct} % of files ({guard_key}). Review it?
backup.notify.stale: No successful backup of {job} in {days} days.
backup.notify.offline: {job} couldn't run: {dest} has not been connected for a while.
backup.notify.usb_running: {job} is backing up to {drive}. Don't unplug it.
backup.notify.usb_done: {job} is done. You can safely eject {drive}.
backup.notify.migrated: {count} backup tasks moved from Scheduled Tasks to Backup & Sync, with safety checks added.
backup.notify.decision_timeout: {job} waited 3 days for your review and was cancelled. Nothing was changed.
backup.notify.clock_unsynced: The server clock isn't synchronised, so scheduled backups may run at the wrong time.
backup.notify.partial: {job} finished, but {errors} files couldn't be copied.
backup.notify.preview_ready: The first run of {job} is ready to review. Nothing has been copied yet.
backup.notify.restart_gave_up: {job} stopped {targets} for a backup, and they couldn't be started again for a day. Start them yourself.
backup.migrate.note.move_to_copy: Was "Move", now "Copy new files", so your originals are never deleted.
backup.migrate.note.dest_excluded: The destination is inside the source, so {path} is now skipped.
backup.migrate.note.unresolved_source: The source {path} wasn't found. The job is paused until it is back or you choose it again; the task keeps running in Scheduled Tasks meanwhile.
backup.migrate.note.unresolved_dest: The destination {path} wasn't found. The job is paused until it is back or you choose it again; the task keeps running in Scheduled Tasks meanwhile.
backup.migrate.note.dropped_args: These extra options have no equivalent and were dropped: {args}
backup.migrate.note.dest_overlap: Another backup job already uses this destination. The job is paused until you choose a folder of its own; the task keeps running in Scheduled Tasks meanwhile.
backup.field.out_of_range: This value is out of range.
backup.field.too_many: Too many items. An archive can hold up to 16 sources.
backup.field.mirror_needs_dest: A mirror only runs when its destination is available.
backup.field.dest_overlaps_job: Another backup job already uses this folder, or a folder inside or around it. Choose a folder of its own.
backup.err.engine_unavailable.title: Backup engine not ready
backup.err.engine_unavailable.cause: The backup engine is starting or restarting.
backup.err.engine_unavailable.fix: The run waits and starts on its own. If this lasts, restart NivaroOS.
backup.err.network_unreachable.title: Network unreachable
backup.err.network_unreachable.cause: The destination couldn't be reached over the network.
backup.err.network_unreachable.fix: Check the network connection. The run is retried automatically.
backup.err.cloud_rate_limited.title: Cloud service is busy
backup.err.cloud_rate_limited.cause: The cloud service asked NivaroOS to slow down.
backup.err.cloud_rate_limited.fix: Nothing to do: the run is retried automatically.
backup.err.dest_offline.title: Destination not connected
backup.err.dest_offline.cause: The destination drive or share isn't connected or mounted.
backup.err.dest_offline.fix: Connect the drive or share. The job runs when it's available.
backup.err.source_offline.title: Source not connected
backup.err.source_offline.cause: The drive or share with the files to back up isn't connected.
backup.err.source_offline.fix: Connect it, then run the job again.
backup.err.io_error.title: Read or write error
backup.err.io_error.cause: A file couldn't be read or written.
backup.err.io_error.fix: Open the log for details, then run the job again.
backup.err.busy.title: App or VM is busy
backup.err.busy.cause: A scheduled task was working on the same app or virtual machine.
backup.err.system_disk_full.title: System disk almost full
backup.err.system_disk_full.cause: Backup & Sync keeps its logs and lists on the system disk, and it has too little free space left for a run.
backup.err.system_disk_full.fix: Free up space on the system disk, then run the job again.
backup.err.cloud_quota_daily.title: Daily upload limit reached
backup.err.cloud_quota_daily.cause: The cloud service allows only a certain amount of uploads per day.
backup.err.cloud_quota_daily.fix: Nothing to do: the job continues after midnight.
backup.err.delete_guard.title: Would delete many files
backup.err.delete_guard.cause: This run would delete more files at the destination than your safety limit allows.
backup.err.delete_guard.fix: Review the changes. If they're expected, continue.
backup.err.change_guard.title: Would change many files
backup.err.change_guard.cause: This run would change more files than your safety limit allows. Ransomware can cause this.
backup.err.change_guard.fix: Review the changes before you continue.
backup.err.empty_source.title: Source looks empty
backup.err.empty_source.cause: The source has far fewer files than at the last backup. A drive may be missing.
backup.err.empty_source.fix: Check the source folder, then review the run.
backup.err.dest_marker_mismatch.title: Different destination folder
backup.err.dest_marker_mismatch.cause: The destination isn't the folder this job wrote to, or the right drive isn't mounted.
backup.err.dest_marker_mismatch.fix: Connect the right drive, or reconnect the job to this folder.
backup.err.dest_inside_source.title: Destination is inside the source
backup.err.dest_inside_source.cause: The destination folder sits inside the folder being backed up, so the backup would copy itself.
backup.err.dest_inside_source.fix: Choose a destination outside the source.
backup.err.path_not_allowed.title: Folder not allowed
backup.err.path_not_allowed.cause: NivaroOS can't back up to or from this folder.
backup.err.path_not_allowed.fix: Choose a folder on a data drive, a USB drive, a share or a cloud account.
backup.err.fat32_file_too_large.title: File too large for this drive
backup.err.fat32_file_too_large.cause: The drive uses FAT32, which can't store files of 4 GB or more.
backup.err.fat32_file_too_large.fix: Skip large files, or use a drive formatted as exFAT, NTFS or ext4.
backup.err.case_collision.title: Names differ only in case
backup.err.case_collision.cause: Some files differ only in upper- and lower-case letters, which the destination treats as the same name.
backup.err.case_collision.fix: Rename those files, or choose a different destination.
backup.err.endpoint_unknown.title: Location not found
backup.err.endpoint_unknown.cause: The drive, share or cloud account this job uses no longer exists.
backup.err.endpoint_unknown.fix: Edit the job and choose the location again.
backup.err.ambiguous_device.title: Two identical drives
backup.err.ambiguous_device.cause: Two connected drives look identical, so NivaroOS can't tell which one to use.
backup.err.ambiguous_device.fix: Unplug one of them, or give one a new filesystem ID in Storage.
backup.err.cloud_auth.title: Cloud sign-in expired
backup.err.cloud_auth.cause: The cloud account's sign-in expired or was revoked.
backup.err.cloud_auth.fix: Sign in to the cloud account again in Storage.
backup.err.no_space.title: Not enough space
backup.err.no_space.cause: The destination doesn't have enough free space for this backup.
backup.err.no_space.fix: Free up space, or choose a bigger destination.
backup.err.invalid_filter.title: Invalid pattern
backup.err.invalid_filter.cause: One of the skip or include patterns isn't valid.
backup.err.invalid_filter.fix: Fix the pattern in the job's settings.
backup.err.appdata_cloud_needs_archive.c: Cloud storage can't keep file owners and links, which apps and VMs need.
backup.err.window_closed.title: Outside the allowed time
backup.err.window_closed.cause: The job may only run inside its time window.
backup.err.window_closed.fix: It runs in the next window, or change the window.
backup.err.app_stop_failed.title: App didn't stop
backup.err.app_stop_failed.cause: An app couldn't be stopped before the backup, so nothing was copied.
backup.err.app_stop_failed.fix: Check the app, or change which apps are stopped.
backup.err.app_start_failed.title: App didn't start again
backup.err.app_start_failed.cause: An app stopped for the backup couldn't be started again.
backup.err.app_start_failed.fix: Start the app from the App Store or dashboard.
backup.err.vm_shutdown_timeout.title: VM didn't shut down
backup.err.vm_shutdown_timeout.cause: The virtual machine didn't shut down in time (no ACPI or guest agent?). Nothing was copied and the VM is still running.
backup.err.vm_shutdown_timeout.fix: Install the guest agent in the VM, or shut it down yourself before the backup.
backup.err.vm_start_failed.title: VM didn't start again
backup.err.vm_start_failed.cause: The virtual machine shut down for the backup couldn't be started again.
backup.err.interrupted.title: Interrupted
backup.err.interrupted.fix: Nothing to do: the run starts again automatically.
backup.err.cancelled_by_user.title: Cancelled
backup.err.cancelled_by_user.cause: The run was cancelled. Files already copied stay.
backup.err.cancelled_by_user.fix: Run the job again when you're ready.
backup.err.cancelled_unmounted.title: Drive removed during the run
backup.err.cancelled_unmounted.cause: The destination was unplugged or unmounted while files were being copied.
backup.err.cancelled_unmounted.fix: Connect the drive and run the job again.
backup.err.max_duration.title: Took too long
backup.err.max_duration.cause: The run exceeded its maximum duration.
backup.err.max_duration.fix: Run it again (it continues where it stopped), or raise the limit.
backup.err.decision_timeout.title: Review not answered
backup.err.decision_timeout.cause: The run waited 3 days for your review and was cancelled. Nothing was changed.
backup.err.decision_timeout.fix: Run the job again and review it.
backup.err.internal.title: Something went wrong
backup.err.internal.cause: An unexpected error happened in Backup & Sync.
backup.err.internal.fix: Open the log for details and try again.
backup.err.validation.title: Check the highlighted fields
backup.err.validation.fix: Fix the highlighted fields and save again.
backup.err.revision_conflict.title: Changed somewhere else
backup.err.revision_conflict.cause: This job was changed in another window since you opened it.
backup.err.revision_conflict.fix: Reload the job and make your changes again.
backup.err.not_found.title: Not found
backup.err.not_found.cause: It was deleted or never existed.
backup.err.unauthorized.title: Signed out
backup.err.forbidden.title: Administrators only
backup.err.forbidden.cause: Only an administrator can change backups.
backup.err.rate_limited.title: Too many requests
backup.err.rate_limited.cause: Too many changes were made in a short time.
backup.err.rate_limited.fix: Wait a minute and try again.
backup.err.store_unavailable.title: Backup database unavailable
backup.err.store_unavailable.cause: The Backup & Sync database couldn't be opened.
backup.err.store_unavailable.fix: Restart NivaroOS. If this stays, check the system disk.
backup.err.invalid_state.title: Not possible right now
backup.err.invalid_state.cause: This action doesn't apply to the run or job in its current state.
backup.err.token_invalid.title: Download link expired
backup.err.token_invalid.cause: Download links work once, for one minute.
backup.app.unavailable.title: Backup & Sync isn't answering
backup.app.unavailable.cause: The Backup & Sync service isn't running, or it was removed from this server.
backup.app.unavailable.fix: Your backups don't run while it's stopped. Start it with: sudo systemctl start nivaroos-backup. If it was removed, run the NivaroOS installer again with --with-backup.
backup.app.source_not_backupable: This folder can't be backed up from here. Choose it again in the new job.
backup.app.dest_not_usable: This drive can't take backups from here. Choose it again in the new job.
backup.overview.upcoming_none: Nothing is scheduled. Jobs you run by hand only run when you start them.
backup.attention.waiting.title: Waiting for your review
backup.attention.waiting.cause: This run stopped before changing anything, because it would delete or change more files than usual. Review it to continue or cancel it.
backup.attention.migrated_unresolved.cau: This job came from Scheduled Tasks, but its source or destination wasn't found. Choose it again to turn the job on.
backup.attention.partial.title: Some files weren't copied
backup.attention.partial.cause: The last run finished, but a few files couldn't be copied. The log lists them.
backup.attention.stale.title: No recent backup
backup.attention.stale.cause: This job hasn't finished successfully for a while, so your newest files may not be protected.
backup.empty.title: Create your first backup
backup.empty.text: A backup keeps a second copy of your files on another drive, a network share or a cloud account, so a broken disk or a deleted folder doesn't cost you your photos, documents or app data. Pick a starting point - you can change everything before it runs.
backup.empty.photos: Back up photos to a USB drive
backup.empty.photos_hint: Runs by itself whenever the drive is plugged in.
backup.empty.apps_hint: Saves your apps' data every night, stopping them briefly so nothing is half-written.
backup.empty.scratch_hint: Choose what, where and when yourself.
backup.explain.sync_note: Sync keeps two places the same, so a file deleted in one is deleted in the other. A backup keeps copies you can go back to. Mirror does both: it matches your files, and keeps what it would delete in a recycle folder for a while.
backup.jobs.none: You don't have any backup jobs yet.
backup.jobs.on_plug_in: When the drive is plugged in
backup.jobs.paused: {name} is paused. It won't run by itself until you resume it.

backup.jobs.delete_purge: Also delete the backup data on the destination
backup.jobs.delete_purge_on: Every copy and version this job made will be deleted. This can't be undone.
backup.jobs.delete_purge_off: The backed-up files stay where they are.
backup.jobs.delete_running: This job is running. Cancel the run first, then delete the job.
backup.jobs.reconnect_message: The folder on {dest} doesn't carry this job's marker - it may belong to another job or another server. Reconnect only if it's this job's backup folder.
backup.jobs.reconnect_other_message: The folder on {dest} holds the backup of a different job, maybe from before a reinstall or from another server. If you take it over, this job treats it as its own: a mirror deletes whatever there isn't in its source. Take it over only if you're sure.
backup.jobs.when_unmet.wait: otherwise it waits and tries again
backup.jobs.safety: Stops and asks you if a run would delete more than {delete} % or change more than {change} % of the files.
backup.jobs.retry: Tries again {count} time | Tries again {count} times
backup.keep.copy_never_deletes: Nothing is ever deleted at the destination

backup.restore.no_jobs: There is nothing to restore yet. Once a backup job has run, its files show up here.
backup.restore.no_versions: This job hasn't saved anything yet.
backup.restore.copy_note: This job keeps one copy, always up to date. Browse it to get files back.
backup.restore.conflict: If a file is already there
backup.restore.conflict_keep_both_hint: The restored copy is named like "photo (restored {date}).jpg".
backup.restore.conflict_overwrite_hint: The file there now is replaced by the backed-up one.
backup.restore.conflict_skip_hint: The file there now stays as it is.
backup.restore.overwrite_warning: Replaced files can't be brought back, unless another backup has them.

backup.run.progress_unknown: Working out how much there is to copy
backup.run.queued_note: Waiting for its turn - another backup is using the drive or the network.
backup.run.cancel_confirm: Files already copied stay at the destination.
backup.run.cancel_confirm_restore: Files already restored stay where they are.
backup.run.file_errors: {count} file couldn't be copied | {count} files couldn't be copied

backup.log.trimmed: Showing the last {count} lines. Download has the whole log.

backup.settings.max_concurrent: Jobs that run at the same time
backup.settings.max_concurrent_hint: 1 to 4. Cloud jobs still run one at a time.
backup.settings.default_delete_pct_hint: A mirror run that would delete more files than this stops and asks you.
backup.settings.default_change_pct_hint: A run that would change more files than this stops and asks you.
backup.settings.default_versions_days_hi: How long a mirror keeps deleted and replaced files. 0 keeps them forever.
backup.settings.catch_up_default: Run missed backups after the server starts
backup.settings.catch_up_default_hint: If the server was off at a scheduled time, the run happens once it's back.
backup.settings.drives_hint: Drives your jobs back up to. The name is only shown here - it doesn't change the drive.
backup.settings.drives_none: No USB drives are used by your jobs.
backup.settings.forget_message: {name} is removed from this list. Nothing on the drive is changed.
backup.settings.forget_in_use: A job still backs up to this drive. Change or delete that job first.
backup.settings.devices_hint: Phones set up in the NivaroOS app to back up to this server. Each phone saves into its own folder. If a phone is lost or you no longer use it, remove it here: it stops backing up straight away.
backup.settings.devices_none: No phones are set up yet. To add one, open the NivaroOS app on the phone and turn on backup.
backup.settings.devices_error: Couldn't load the list of phones.
backup.settings.device_remove_message: {name} can no longer back up to this server. Backups it already saved in {path} are kept. To use it again, set it up again in the app.
backup.settings.import_pending: Not imported yet - Scheduled Tasks wasn't reachable. It's tried again automatically.
backup.settings.import_failed: The last import didn't finish. Your Scheduled Tasks are unchanged. Try again below.
backup.settings.import_nothing: There were no backup or sync tasks to import.
backup.shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
backup.summary.copy: Copies new and changed files from {source} to {dest}.
backup.summary.archive: Saves {source} as one compressed archive in {dest} on every run.
backup.summary.when_plug: Runs every time {drive} is plugged in.
backup.summary.when_plug_gap: Runs when {drive} is plugged in, at most once every {hours} hours.
backup.summary.when_manual: Runs only when you start it.
backup.summary.catch_up: A run missed while the server was off runs after start-up.
backup.summary.unmet_skip: If the destination isn't available, that run is skipped.
backup.summary.unmet_wait: If the destination isn't available, it waits for it for up to {hours} hours.
backup.summary.unmet_fail: If the destination isn't available, the run fails and you are notified.
backup.summary.guards: Stops and asks you first if a run would delete more than {delete} % or change more than {change} % of the files.
backup.summary.guard_change: Stops and asks you first if a run would change more than {change} % of the files.
backup.summary.stop_apps: Stops {apps} during the backup and starts them again after.
backup.summary.stop_apps_each: Stops {apps} one at a time during the backup and starts each again after.
backup.summary.shutdown_vm: Shuts down {vm} during the backup and starts it again after.
backup.summary.skips: Skips {count} kinds of files you chose.
backup.summary.preview_first: Shows you what the first run will change before it changes anything.
backup.summary.retry: If a run fails, it is retried up to {n} times.
backup.summary.no_retry: A failed run is not retried.
backup.loc.none: No storage found. Connect a drive, a network share or a cloud account.
backup.loc.offline_usb_note: This drive isn't plugged in now. The job runs when it is connected again.
backup.loc.same_disk_note: This is the same physical disk as the source. If the disk fails, the original and the backup are lost together.
backup.loc.quirks_label: Things to know about this location
backup.folder.empty: No folders here. You can use this folder, or add a new one.
backup.folder.truncated: Only the first 2000 entries are shown.
backup.folder.created_on_run: The folder is created on the first run.

backup.preview.title_copy: Preview: what this copy run will do
backup.preview.title_archive: Preview: what this archive run will do
backup.preview.title_guard: This run is paused for your review
backup.preview.working: Working out what this run will change…
backup.preview.working_hint: Nothing is changed yet. On large folders this can take a few minutes.

backup.preview.delete_note_forever: {n} files at the destination aren't in your source. They'll be moved to the recycle folder and kept.
backup.preview.nothing: Everything is already up to date. This run has nothing to change.
backup.preview.no_plan: The list of changes isn't available for this run.

backup.preview.cancelled: The run was cancelled. Nothing was changed.

backup.wizard.start.title: What would you like to protect?

backup.wizard.what.title: What to back up
backup.wizard.what.type_needs_archive: Not possible for app data or VMs in the cloud.
backup.wizard.what.explainer_title: What happens if I delete a file?
backup.wizard.what.explainer_sync: None of these change your originals. A job only ever writes to its destination.
backup.wizard.what.auto_archive: Switched to Archive: cloud storage can't keep the file owners and links that apps and VMs need.
backup.wizard.what.auto_mirror: Switched to Mirror, which keeps owners and links on this destination.
backup.wizard.what.source_heading: What do you want to protect?
backup.wizard.what.one_source_hint: A mirror or copy job protects one folder. To protect several in one job, choose Archive.
backup.wizard.what.many_needs_archive: A mirror or copy job protects one folder. Keep one, or save them all in one archive.
backup.wizard.what.consistency_hint: Data copied while an app or VM is running can be damaged. It is stopped for the backup and started again after. Anything already stopped stays stopped.
backup.wizard.what.stop_app_off: {app} keeps running. If it writes a database during the copy, the copy may not open.
backup.wizard.what.app_mode_each: One at a time (each is down for less time)
backup.wizard.what.shutdown_vm_note: It is started again after the backup.
backup.wizard.what.shutdown_vm_off: The disk of a running VM may not start from the copy.
backup.wizard.what.pattern_hint: * matches within a folder name, ** across folders. A pattern starting with / is relative to the source folder.
backup.wizard.where.title: Where to save
backup.wizard.where.hint_usb: Choose the USB drive. It is recognised by its identity, so it works whichever port you use.
backup.wizard.where.hint_cloud: Choose a cloud account, so a copy lives outside your home.
backup.wizard.where.hint_local: Choose another drive than the one the files are on.
backup.wizard.where.folder_hint: Created on the first run if it doesn't exist.
backup.wizard.where.browse_offline: Connect the drive to browse it.
backup.wizard.where.cloud_needs_archive: Cloud storage can't keep file owners and links. Use Archive for app data.
backup.wizard.where.checking: Checking the source and the destination…
backup.wizard.where.checks_unavailable: The checks couldn't run right now. They run again before every backup.
backup.wizard.where.needs_ok_partial: Needs at least {need} (still counting). {free} free, OK so far.
backup.wizard.where.needs_short: Needs about {need}, but only {free} is free.
backup.wizard.where.needs_unknown_free: Needs about {need}. The free space of this location isn't known.
backup.wizard.when.title: When to run
backup.wizard.when.on_plug_generic: When a drive is plugged in
backup.wizard.when.plug_needs_drive: Available when the source or the destination is a drive.
backup.wizard.when.plug_gap_hint: Set it to 0 to run every time the drive is plugged in.
backup.wizard.when.catch_up: If a run was missed (the server was off), run it after start-up
backup.wizard.when.manual_only: Manual only: this job runs when you start it.
backup.wizard.when.unmet_hint.skip: A skipped run isn't a failure. It shows in grey in the activity list.
backup.wizard.when.unmet_hint.wait: Checks again every 5 minutes, then skips the run.
backup.wizard.when.unmet_hint.fail: You get a notification each time.
backup.wizard.when.window_hint: Runs that come up outside these hours wait for them.
backup.wizard.when.retry_hint: Only for problems that can pass on their own, like the network. Waits {delays} between tries.
backup.wizard.when.retry_off_hint: A failed run waits for the next scheduled time.
backup.wizard.keep.title: What to keep
backup.wizard.keep.recycle_days: Keep deleted and replaced files for
backup.wizard.keep.recycle_hint: They go to a recycle folder at the destination, so you can restore them.
backup.wizard.keep.recycle_forever_hint: 0 keeps them forever. The destination then keeps growing.
backup.wizard.keep.keep_last_hint: Older archives are removed after a successful run.
backup.wizard.keep.guard_intro: Stop and ask me first if a run would
backup.wizard.keep.guard_hint: Catches a wrong folder, an unplugged drive or ransomware before the backup copies the damage.
backup.wizard.keep.empty_source: Stop and ask if the source suddenly has
backup.wizard.keep.preview_first_hint: Shows you every file the first run would add, change or delete before anything happens.
backup.wizard.keep.verify_hint: Compares checksums after each run. Takes longer.
backup.wizard.keep.verify_blocked: Not available: this destination has no checksums to compare.
backup.wizard.review.title: Review and create
backup.wizard.review.imported: Imported from Scheduled Tasks, with safety checks added. Saving it once removes the “Imported” badge.
backup.wizard.review.name: Name
backup.wizard.review.name_hint: Leave it empty to use the name shown.
backup.wizard.review.low_priority_hint: Leaves CPU and disk time to your apps. The backup takes longer.
backup.wizard.review.include_hint: One pattern per line, like *.jpg. Leave empty to include everything not skipped.
backup.wizard.review.allow_empty_hint: Normally an empty source stops the run, in case a drive is missing.
backup.wizard.review.notify_success: Notify me when a run succeeds
backup.wizard.review.notify_failure: Notify me when a run fails
backup.wizard.review.notify_failure_hint: Always on, so a broken backup never goes unnoticed.
backup.wizard.review.run_now_preview: Start the first run now (you review it before anything changes)
